text: Alternative funds gave retail investors access to hedge fund strategies and higher returns than traditional mutual funds while charging mutual fund fees, and that combination is what increased retail demand.
citation: Kaal, Confluence of Mutual and Private Funds (2016). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=2715083

isBasedOn.name: Confluence of Mutual and Private Funds

abstract: Alternative funds offered retail investors access to hedge fund strategies and higher returns than mutual funds while paying mutual fund fees, thus increasing demand by retail investors.
